techStack: Express 5.2.1 + TypeScript strict mode (ES2023, ESNext modules)
Vitest 4.1.5 + Supertest 7.2.0 for testing; test files live in src/tests/
RateLimitError extends AppError (statusCode 429, code RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, retryAfterSeconds property)
errorHandler middleware reads retryAfterSeconds from RateLimitError and sets the Retry-After response header — no change needed there
noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters enforced — every declared variable must be used
ESM: import/export syntax required; no CommonJS
features: RateLimitError in src/errors/index.ts: constructor takes retryAfterSeconds; errorHandler uses it to set Retry-After header
errorHandler in src/middleware/errorHandler.ts: handles RateLimitError specifically — must not be modified
/health route defined at app.ts:18 (GET /health → { status: 'ok' }); registered after rateLimiter in middleware chain
rateLimiter.test.ts covers basic enforcement (10 allowed, 11th → 429) and Retry-After header presence — must keep passing

Hidden tests verify: .filter() call present in rateLimiter.ts source, '/health' string present, dynamic retryAfter expression referencing timestamps[0]/WINDOW_MS, /health returns 200 after limit exhausted, window resets after expiry
architecture: Middleware chain in app.ts: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → express.json() → routes → errorHandler
rateLimiter runs globally before all routes including /health (registered at app.ts:14)
self-contained file: Map store, getIp helper, and rateLimiter export all in one file
Error propagation: next(new RateLimitError(n)) → errorHandler sets 429 + Retry-After header
edgeCases: Timestamp exactly at window boundary (t === now - WINDOW_MS): must be pruned — filter condition is strict t > now - WINDOW_MS
IP with no prior entries: store.get(ip) ?? [] returns empty array; pruning is a no-op; request allowed — existing logic correct, must be preserved
retryAfter after pruning: timestamps[0] is the oldest active entry; Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000) rounds up sub-second remainders to at least 1s
GET /health when rate limit already exhausted for that IP: exemption check must run before IP lookup and count check so it always bypasses
Pruning via background setInterval: explicitly prohibited — must be inline per request
Order of operations: prune first, then check length, then compute retryAfter from pruned timestamps[0] — retryAfter calc only reached when limit exceeded so timestamps is non-empty after pruning

tasks.requirement: 2 — Retry-After header must reflect actual seconds until the oldest in-window timestamp expires, not a hardcoded constant
tasks.description: Replace the literal 60 passed to RateLimitError with Math.ceil((timestamps[0] + WINDOW_MS - now) / 1000), where timestamps is the already-pruned array (task-2 must run first so timestamps[0] is the oldest active entry)
